# Implementation-Readiness Checklist: Signup UI Parity — Desktop + Mobile

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality and implementation-readiness criteria for objectively assessing the approved Feature 003 specification and plan before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-09-20
**Feature**: [Signup UI Parity specification](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command from the approved Feature 003 context.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Scope and Architecture Boundaries

- [ ] CHK001 Are the Signup-local source surface and the exact-asset-only exception explicitly bounded, with unrelated screens, shells, dependencies, and refactors excluded? [Completeness, Spec §Scope Boundaries; Plan §Canonical Surface and Protection Rules]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements clear that local composition is the default and that any shared change requires proof, an opt-in shape, and identified consumers? [Clarity, Spec §Shared Component Safety Requirements; Plan §Canonical Surface and Protection Rules]
- [ ] CHK003 Are `Input`, `Button`, and `AuthHeader` protected from API/default changes consistently across the specification and plan? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context; Plan §Canonical Surface and Protection Rules]
- [ ] CHK004 Are AuthService, Supabase, API, database, and data-model non-change boundaries explicitly stated without introducing a new contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011; Data Model §No data-model change]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the no-unrelated-formatting, no-unrelated-refactoring, no-unrelated-repository-change, and no-`.env.local`/secret-exposure boundaries documented as reviewable constraints? [Completeness, Constitution §Technical Stack & Architectural Constraints; Quickstart §Technical checks]

## Visual Authority and Responsive Requirements

- [ ] CHK006 Are Desktop file/node, viewport, and directly measurable geometry requirements specified as the visual authority rather than inferred from existing code? [Traceability, Spec §VR-001–VR-017]
- [ ] CHK007 Are Mobile file/node, 390 × 940 default-frame geometry, 80px header, and 860px default Main region explicitly separated from Desktop authority? [Traceability, Spec §VR-001; Spec §VR-018]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the `md` / 768px boundary, below-`md` Mobile composition, at/above-`md` Desktop composition, and tablet-width expectations stated without ambiguity? [Clarity, Plan §Responsive Direction; Research §Decision: `md` breakpoint; Quickstart §Responsive and behavior checks]
- [ ] CHK009 Are exact Desktop card width, padding, radius, default-state height, shadow, header/main offsets, and accent values sufficiently quantified for objective parity review? [Measurability, Spec §VR-003–VR-017]
- [ ] CHK010 Are exact Mobile gutters, intro offsets, subtitle dimensions/copy, field sizes, submit size, and footer offset sufficiently quantified for objective parity review? [Measurability, Spec §VR-018–VR-032]
- [ ] CHK011 Are typography, colors, line heights, tracking, and approved fractional values specified consistently wherever they materially affect Desktop or Mobile parity? [Consistency, Spec §VR-005–VR-016; Plan §Desktop Design Approach]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the exact-asset strategy explicit about byte-identical reuse, stable local promotion, source/destination/format/dimensions/SHA evidence, and prohibition of temporary MCP URLs or approximated SVGs? [Completeness, Spec §VR-033; Plan §Asset Plan]
- [ ] CHK013 Are Desktop and Mobile visual-validation requirements explicitly tied to their exact nodes, target viewport dimensions, and the sole authorized Confirm Password divergence? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §VR-001; Spec §FR-020; Spec §SC-001–SC-002]

## Form State and Functional Preservation

- [ ] CHK014 Are all five controlled fields and the empty production initial state defined, with Figma-populated Name/Password values unambiguously limited to visual/test examples? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-002; Spec §FR-018–FR-019; Data Model §Existing client state to preserve]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the existing Name, Email, Password-complexity, Confirm Password matching, and optional Job Title rules fully stated and traceable to TM-03? [Consistency, TM-03 §Requirements; Spec §FR-003–FR-006; Data Model §Validation rules]
- [ ] CHK016 Are independent Password and Confirm Password visibility states, value preservation, accessible names, and the Confirm Password control as the sole authorized visual divergence all explicitly constrained? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007; Spec §FR-016; Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK017 Are Desktop-visible validation-checklist requirements and Mobile visually-hidden-but-functionally-active validation requirements documented without implying a validation-rule change? [Consistency, Spec §VR-014; Spec §VR-030; Data Model §Validation rules]
- [ ] CHK018 Are field-error and server/API-error clearing, loading/disabled/duplicate-submit behavior, and unexpected-error handling specified as preserved behavior rather than redesign scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-013]
- [ ] CHK019 Are metadata trimming and `name` / `job_title` mapping, user-plus-session redirect, user-without-session failure path, and Login route requirements defined precisely? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012; Spec §FR-014–FR-017]

## Accessibility and Dynamic Error-State Requirements

- [ ] CHK020 Are label association, invalid-state/descriptive/error relationships, alert semantics, keyboard operation, focus visibility, and visibility-control names defined for both viewport authorities? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016; Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the existing error-presentation preservation boundary and the prohibition on inventing a new error design stated consistently across plan and quickstart? [Consistency, Plan §Mobile Design Approach; Quickstart §Mobile error-state checks]
- [ ] CHK022 Are Desktop natural card expansion requirements explicit for field, API/server, unexpected-error, and accessibility feedback states? [Coverage, Plan §Desktop Design Approach; Plan §Risks and Mitigations]
- [ ] CHK023 Are Mobile dynamic-content growth and vertical document scrolling defined as distinct from the 860px default visual state? [Clarity, Plan §Mobile Design Approach; Quickstart §Mobile error-state checks]
- [ ] CHK024 Is unsafe fixed-height plus `overflow-hidden` clipping expressly prohibited for field errors, API/server errors, unexpected alerts, accessible feedback, submit action, and Login footer? [Completeness, Plan §Mobile Design Approach]
- [ ] CHK025 Are single-field, multiple-field, Password, Confirm Password, API/server, unexpected-alert, and long-accessible-feedback scenarios all specified as necessary error-state review coverage? [Coverage, Quickstart §Mobile error-state checks]
- [ ] CHK026 Are scrolling, keyboard/focus visibility while scrolling, and submit/Login-footer reachability stated as measurable requirements for dynamic Mobile states? [Measurability, Quickstart §Mobile error-state checks]

## Validation and Review Gates

- [ ] CHK027 Are the bounded existing-test strategy and explicit no-new-test-framework constraint documented without requiring unrelated test infrastructure? [Scope, Plan §Testing and Validation; Research §Decision: testing]
- [ ] CHK028 Are Desktop visual review, Mobile visual review, validation/error-state review, loading/disabled review, and around-768px/tablet review all prescribed as separate observable validation dimensions? [Completeness, Plan §Testing and Validation; Quickstart §§Desktop checks, Mobile checks, Responsive and behavior checks]
- [ ] CHK029 Is targeted Prettier limited to exact Feature-touched files, with global reformatting explicitly excluded? [Clarity, Constitution §Quality Gates & Git Discipline; Quickstart §Technical checks]
- [ ] CHK030 Are pnpm-only command use, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`, `pnpm build`, relevant existing tests, and `git diff --check` all explicitly required validation gates? [Completeness, Constitution §Quality Gates & Git Discipline; Quickstart §Technical checks]
- [ ] CHK031 Is `pnpm exec next typegen` clearly conditional on a change requiring regenerated Next.js types, rather than an unconditional or omitted gate? [Clarity, Quickstart §Technical checks]

## Cross-Artifact Consistency and Readiness

- [ ] CHK032 Are the spec, plan, research, data model, and quickstart mutually consistent that this Feature changes presentation only and introduces no API, database, or Supabase contract change? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011; Plan §Technical Context; Research §Decision: Signup-local composition; Data Model §No data-model change]
- [ ] CHK033 Are Desktop natural expansion and Mobile dynamic growth requirements consistent with their respective fixed default Figma geometries, without treating either default height as a functional maximum? [Consistency, Spec §VR-004; Spec §VR-018; Plan §§Desktop Design Approach, Mobile Design Approach]
- [ ] CHK034 Are the protected shared-component boundaries consistent with the existing source evidence that the Signup page currently composes `Input`, `Button`, `AuthHeader`, AuthService, and password utilities? [Traceability, Plan §Technical Context; Plan §Canonical Surface and Protection Rules]
- [ ] CHK035 Do Figma authority, TM-03 functional authority, existing-behavior preservation, and asset requirements remain explicitly separated so no visual requirement silently changes authentication behavior? [Consistency, Constitution §Core Principle II; Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Functional Safeguards]
- [ ] CHK036 Are no unresolved `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]`, contradictory scope instructions, invented requirements, or unbounded assumptions present in the approved artifact set? [Readiness, Requirements Checklist §Requirement Completeness; Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Rollback / Scope Safety]

## Explicit Responsive Password Layout Requirements

- [ ] CHK037 Are Desktop Password and Confirm Password requirements explicit as two 232px columns with a 16px horizontal gap, applying at `md` / 768px and above? [Measurability, Spec §VR-011; Plan §§Responsive Direction, Desktop Design Approach]
- [ ] CHK038 Are Mobile Password and Confirm Password requirements explicit as one stacked column with a 24px vertical gap, applying below `md` / 768px? [Measurability, Spec §VR-028; Plan §§Responsive Direction, Mobile Design Approach]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
